method: Train-only companion on the588late fused features; higher late-path LR, lower early LR, MixUp on half batches, frozen BN refs, EMA/student validation. Inference architecture unchanged.
loss: Main weighted smoothed CE +.25 companion CE; MixUp Beta(.2,.2) on half batches, all training faces retained; CE class weight power.25
selection: Validation-only .35 accuracy+.65 macro F1; require no lower accuracy, macro precision/recall/F1 and disgust precision/recall/F1 than initial raw validation. Compare student and EMA.
test: One frozen selected candidate only if validation improves; strict no regression across seven aggregate/disgust metrics before integration. Historical test remains previously inspected; no80% promise.
assumptions: Companion width128, feature slice588, LR groups and training recipe are project choices. No causal architecture claim, external teacher, FER+ label merge or new physiological metric.
